text: dsh-timeout-auto-reject 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的权限请求超时处理插件，通过注册 approval/request 处理器，在人工审批等待期间启动三分钟计时；若用户及时回应则保留原审批结果，超时则中止等待、自动拒绝请求，并向 agent 注入可见提示。浏览器审批卡片还会显示拒绝倒计时。适合希望长时间无人值守运行 DSH、又不想让权限请求无限期挂起的用户。无需额外配置，也不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-timeout-auto-reject handles unanswered DSH Web permissions. Its approval handler starts a three-minute timer: timely responses keep their outcome; otherwise it rejects the request and notifies the agent. The browser card shows a countdown. No extra configuration or API key is required.
DSH 的权限审批一直没人点时，能不能过一会儿自动拒绝？
想让无人值守的 DSH 会话在审批超时后继续运行。
Can an unanswered DSH permission prompt expire automatically and show a countdown?
dsh-timeout-auto-reject 的功能「审批超时自动拒绝」：等待中的权限请求超过三分钟仍未得到人工回应时，插件中止等待并以 rejected 结束请求，同时向 agent 注入超时提示；若用户及时回应，则采用原审批结果。
dsh-timeout-auto-reject 的功能「审批倒计时」：浏览器端观察审批卡片，并在拒绝按钮旁显示距离自动拒绝的剩余秒数；请求超时标记随理由字段传到卡片，倒计时结束后停止刷新。

@jiesou/dsh-timeout-auto-reject README · dsh-timeout-auto-reject：Auto-reject unanswered permission requests. [English](README.en.md) 自动拒绝未应答的权限请求。 任何 permission 请求如果在 180s 内无人应答，插件会自动拒绝，同时向 agent 注入一条模型可见的 `SYSTEM` 提示，agent 不停止，自动继续运行。


@jiesou/dsh-timeout-auto-reject README · dsh-timeout-auto-reject：Any permission request left unanswered for 180s is automatically rejected (fail-closed), and a model-visible `SYSTEM` notice is injected into the agent, which then continues automatically.

Stop being lulled by auto-mode's illusion of safety. When a permission lands on "ask" and you're off-screen, this plugin rejects it by default. Fail-closed is the real safety.

@jiesou/dsh-timeout-auto-reject README · Install：From npm (prebuilt, recommended):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @jiesou/dsh-timeout-auto-reject
```

Or from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiesou/dsh-timeout-auto-reject
```

@jiesou/dsh-timeout-auto-reject README · After installing：No configuration needed.

The implementation is very simple and compact; feel free to edit `src/index.ts`.
